entries.title: The Watchful Caravan Guard

authored_character_exclusions: Do not assign to an established named lore character or a character with an incompatible fixed caravan history.
Do not infer this grievance from race, Orc opponents, personality, equipment, portrait or recruitment circumstances; explicitly assign one individual history instance before introduction.
Do not combine with a second active major personal chain or another individual loyalty-cap proposal until reviewed compatibility rules exist.

entries.core_promise: An aloof caravan guard must distinguish the hostile Orc warband that harmed a convoy from individual Orcs, with the player able to support vengeance, professional focus or earned reconciliation.

facets.claim: Speaks in short, deliberate observations; reserved is a voice habit, not evidence of indifference.
prerequisites: Assign this individual voice tag at character creation.
facets.provenance: Fixed individual voice choice; not inferred from strategist or race.

facets.claim: Keeps conversational distance, especially when a person asks for trust before earning it.
prerequisites: Assign this individual social tag at character creation.
facets.provenance: Fixed social manner; no new base personality is created.

facets.claim: Previously helped guard a particular trade convoy and knows how to keep a moving group together.
prerequisites: A fixed personal background is assigned before the first conversation; disclose at the saved route-memory beat.
facets.provenance: Blueprint-specific latent autobiography supported by background:caravan_guard; not culture-wide history.

facets.claim: A particular hostile Orc warband assaulted the convoy this individual guarded; loss of people and supplies remains unsettled, but no specific survivor or enemy identity is assumed.
prerequisites: Assign history:orc_warband_grievance for this person before introduction; instantiate supporting facts, with no named kingdom or universal Orc behavior.
facets.provenance: Fixed individual latent-history record; first meaningful prisoner introduction reveals the existence of the grievance, not a random new biography.

facets.claim: This individual is presently wary of Orcs because of that particular raid; the grievance does not establish that Orcs generally behave alike.
prerequisites: The fixed grievance exists; a first introduction permits explicit disclosure.
facets.provenance: Individual starting belief, not a racial trait. Retire its active hostile dialogue if and only if transformed.

facets.claim: Wants to improve disciplined convoy protection rather than lose another vulnerable group to a rushed decision.
prerequisites: Discover through the saved professional-practice conversation, not a random mission enemy.
facets.provenance: Professional motive anchored in the caravan-guard background.

facets.claim: After evidence and a voluntary turning point, evaluates an Orc player and other individuals on demonstrated choices rather than shared ancestry.
prerequisites: character_blueprints_pilot_001.guard_01.facet_distrust must already be known and explicitly retired as an active belief;
Resolve the validated warband history, experience a reviewable fair-treatment choice, and explicitly affirm the new distinction at character_blueprints_pilot_001.guard_01.milestone_reckoning.
facets.provenance: Branch-specific belief transformation; do not silently rewrite history or auto-trigger from killing Orcs.

facets.claim: Can commit to watching the player’s back as a chosen, loyal companion while remaining quiet and independent-minded.
prerequisites: Finish the reconciliatory branch and accept an explicit platonic pledge after concrete conduct proves trust; no romance or gender gate.
facets.provenance: Player-chosen relational development only; not a base personality, combat-AI change or romance.

remaining_reveal_beats.beat: At a saved companion talk, the guard explains a practical convoy decision that once went wrong; reveal only the fixed caravan background.
A separate discussion about keeping people safe reveals deliberate tactical pride rather than bloodlust.
Only a branch-verified act of fair treatment, followed by a conscious reappraisal, replaces the old active belief; may never occur.
Only a separately accepted, platonic commitment in the reconciliation aftermath develops this bond; may never occur.

establishment.established_when: The saved prisoner introduction and the two ordinary companion conversations reveal reserved bearing, aloofness, specific grievance, initial distrust, caravan background and protection motive; reconciliation and devotion are optional development, not prerequisites to understanding this person.

reveal_beats: Saved, one-time first meaningful prisoner conversation; the guard stands apart, observes routes out and only then discusses terms of joining.

Personal disclosure: "An Orc warband broke a convoy I guarded. I distrust what I remember, not a fact about every Orc." Reveal fixed grievance and current wariness, not the identity of a random opponent.

Before recruitment or loyalty spending, if and only if player race is Orc, show explicit mechanical proposal: "If recruited, this individual’s loyalty would be capped at 80 until their specific distrust is credibly resolved." This is distinct from prison resistance and must not be applied to current companions.
When player is not Orc, make no claim that an Orc-player cap applies. The player.race fork and cap display cannot be expressed by the current predicate registry.

prospective_loyalty_cap.when: Proposed only for a NEW recruitment of this instantiated character if player.race is Orc AND the character bears the preassigned history:orc_warband_grievance and active belief:distrusts_orcs; player.race is not registered as a predicate.
prospective_loyalty_cap.disclosed_before: At the first meaningful saved prisoner introduction, ahead of a recruitment commitment, loyalty spending or other irreversible investment; explicit 80 ceiling in UI and player options.
prospective_loyalty_cap.cause: This individual’s unresolved personal distrust rooted in the specific hostile warband attack, not Orc ancestry as a global rule and not prisoner recruitment resistance.
prospective_loyalty_cap.lift_condition: Only after the reconciliation path records an evidenced, freely chosen trust bridge and retires active belief:distrusts_orcs; remove this cap without setting actual loyalty to 100. Vengeance or mere Orc kills do not lift it.

player_options.consequence: Save introduction and disclose the proposed 80 cap before acceptance if the player is Orc; no immediate trust increase.

player_options.player_intent: Ask what happened, without demanding trust.
player_options.consequence: Only reveal already assigned convoy history in later saved conversation; no arc is armed by this click.
No hostility, no loyalty cap applied and no one-off consumed; reopening uses the saved same introduction and facts.

conversation_nodes.when: Post-recruitment, first saved talk about earlier work; requires this individual’s fixed background and grievance, not a random Orc target.
conversation_nodes.speaker_intent: Explains an actual convoy-guarding dilemma without rehearsing a universal history of Orcs.

reveal_or_develop.transition: Reveal the preassigned background once; remain careful about unknown victims and unnamed perpetrators.

choices.player_intent: Listen to the practical detail.
choices.consequence: Reveal background once, make no promises about vengeance.

choices.player_intent: Respect their silence for now.
choices.consequence: Keep the same saved topic available; no reroll, no penalty.

conversation_nodes.when: After the route-memory beat; ordinary companion conversation about protecting the party.
conversation_nodes.speaker_intent: Shows that guard work is about preparation and restraint, not only settling old scores.

reveal_or_develop.transition: Reveal a stable professional motive that remains valid in every ending.

choices.player_intent: Ask to hear the guard’s method.
choices.consequence: Reveal the mastery motive, not a grant of a live combat skill.

choices.player_intent: Change the subject.
choices.consequence: The same discussion may resume later without duplicate reveals.

conversation_nodes.when: After background and motive are saved; player asks if the guard wants to seek accountability for the specific warband.
conversation_nodes.speaker_intent: Gives the player control over whether an optional existing-mission interlude may be prepared.

choices.player_intent: Agree to pursue verified evidence and respect an outcome short of a personal killing blow.
choices.consequence: Arm only character_blueprints_pilot_001.guard_01.arc_warband as a latent reviewed opportunity; neither spawn an enemy nor trigger on every Orc.

choices.player_intent: Promise nothing yet.
choices.consequence: Same unarmed discussion stays available; no loss of relationship, reward or arc entitlement.

choices.player_intent: Explicitly decline involvement.
choices.consequence: Close the optional mission offer after confirmation, but preserve a separate ordinary-talk route to identity establishment and non-violent personal closure.

conversation_nodes.when: Only after character_blueprints_pilot_001.guard_01.milestone_encounter records an authenticated result or an explicitly verified unavailable-target fallback.
conversation_nodes.speaker_intent: Wants an accurate account of what happened, especially if someone else dealt the final blow or the target was captured.

choices.player_intent: Record the actual outcome, not a heroic fiction.
choices.consequence: Advance toward truthful reckoning; capture is not called defeat, death is not called capture, and an ally final hit stays credited to that ally.

choices.player_intent: Allow more time before discussing the result.
choices.consequence: Preserve outcome and conversation position, with no additional reward or reroll.

conversation_nodes.when: Only after the guard knowingly chooses the reconciliation resolution of character_blueprints_pilot_001.guard_01.milestone_reckoning; any Orc-player trust bridge must already be verified.
conversation_nodes.speaker_intent: Names one person worth trusting without pretending the convoy raid never happened.

reveal_or_develop.transition: Replace the active blanket distrust with a conscious individuals-first belief.
May develop only if the player opts into the purely platonic protective pledge.

choices.player_intent: Accept an explicitly platonic promise to look out for one another.
choices.consequence: Develop earned devotion once; loyalty may grow normally afterward, but no forced affection, romance or loyalty grant.

choices.player_intent: Welcome trust without a devoted bond.
choices.consequence: Reconciliation still closes the core grievance; devotion stays undeveloped and no loyalty is forced.

personal_arcs.armed_by: character_blueprints_pilot_001.guard_01.node_boundary / character_blueprints_pilot_001.guard_01.boundary_arm after a saved recruitment and profession conversation; not a random Orc encounter.

entry_conditions.review_only_context: Must be a recruited, live character with saved arm choice; encounter must contain an already-existing visible hostile Orc (target.race Orc, target.hostile true) whose membership in the particular warband is independently verified by mission-authored provenance. Neither mission context nor warband membership is registered. No guaranteed encounter.

participants: This instanced guard, conscious for dialog; participation may be downed during battle without erasing already saved context.
The player, whose Orc/non-Orc identity is read only through a requested reviewed player.race capability.

An existing mission enemy: target.present=true, target.known=true, target.hostile=true, target.race=Orc, and actually visible at recognition, PLUS explicit reviewed same-warband membership provenance; Orc ancestry alone never establishes the link.
Existing party allies may act; if a hostile is captured, use the actual finalized capture/recovery system rather than unconscious state.

prerequisites: character_blueprints_pilot_001.guard_01.boundary_arm is saved once; recruited companion; character_blueprints_pilot_001.guard_01.facet_grievance and character_blueprints_pilot_001.guard_01.facet_caravan are supported fixed facts.
milestones.player_objective: Agree that any personal objective must fit a normal mission and may be pursued by the team, not necessarily by this guard personally.
milestones.scoring: Record one consent/arm transition, no prize; defer retains the exact same instance, permanent decline closes the mission offer without penalizing ordinary rapport.

prerequisites: character_blueprints_pilot_001.guard_01.milestone_consent committed; a compatible existing mission has started; registered target predicates plus an unimplemented, verified individual warband-provenance check.
milestones.player_objective: When an eligible enemy becomes visible, let the guard recognize an independently evidenced link and offer a brief, optional accountability objective.
milestones.scoring: No recognition on unseen foes, friendly Orcs or unrelated Orc opponents. Record recognition once; if no verified target appears, remain latent and do not add encounters. No replay farming.

prerequisites: character_blueprints_pilot_001.guard_01.milestone_recognition saved and a reviewed encounter-result event exists for that same bound enemy or verified target-unavailability record.
milestones.player_objective: Choose whether to seek a lawful alive capture when available, accept a team defeat/death, or let the enemy escape rather than force a killing blow.
milestones.scoring: Defeat/downed, death, capture finalized through recovery, escape and retreat are distinct. An ally final hit can satisfy team defeat with exact attribution; guard being down pauses dialog, not mission record. Target death before attribution never fabricates a confrontation. An escape or retreat leaves the same objective pending or permits honest forgoing, never a win. Neither mere damage nor unconsciousness counts as captured.

prerequisites: character_blueprints_pilot_001.guard_01.milestone_encounter has a verified outcome OR a separately reviewed acknowledged-unavailability fallback; the guard is conscious and can consider the actual record.
milestones.player_objective: Offer a documented choice between focusing the grievance into disciplined professional specialization, pursuing fair accountability and personal reconciliation, or accepting unresolved loss when no proof exists.
milestones.scoring: Specialization requires authentic evidence and an accepted path; it need not credit the guard with the final blow. Reconciliation requires an explicit act of fairness and a credible sustained promise, not Orc casualties; for an Orc player this must be a verified action that kept an earlier fair-treatment commitment at a real narrative choice. If evidence or the target remains unavailable, allow deferral or an honest no-reward acceptance of uncertainty, not fictitious revenge. Grant a reviewed reward once per concluded branch.

resolution_branches.name: Settle the warband matter through accountability and sharpen protection craft
resolution_branches.trigger: Verified warband-link and legitimate encounter evidence, followed by the player’s explicit specialization choice; a captured enemy can be processed for accountability without pretending capture is a kill.
resolution_branches.resolved: No further hunt of this specific encounter is owed, and the guard recognizes that a plan and a truthful record did more than an impulsive execution.
resolution_branches.remaining_conflicts: Distrust of Orcs can remain, particularly toward an Orc player; no automatic reconciliation, devotion or cap lift.
resolution_branches.facet_changes: Keep character_blueprints_pilot_001.guard_01.facet_mastery known and character_blueprints_pilot_001.guard_01.facet_distrust active; character_blueprints_pilot_001.guard_01.facet_individuals and character_blueprints_pilot_001.guard_01.facet_devotion remain undeveloped.
resolution_branches.base_personality_change: None; strategist stays strategist, no silent combat-AI changes.

resolution_branches.name: Pursue truthful accountability, distinguish individuals and optionally accept platonic devotion
resolution_branches.trigger: Verified factual reckoning AND an explicitly recorded fair-treatment turning point; an Orc player must first fulfill a consequential prior commitment (for example, support a finalized alive capture and truthful testimony rather than a demanded execution). Without such evidence the branch must defer, not auto-succeed.
resolution_branches.resolved: A personal grievance receives its truthful acknowledgment and the specific player is judged by actions; the guard can put collective suspicion aside.
resolution_branches.remaining_conflicts: Loss stays part of history, and reserved social habits remain; friendship is chosen, not a love story or instant affection.
resolution_branches.facet_changes: Deactivate active character_blueprints_pilot_001.guard_01.facet_distrust and activate character_blueprints_pilot_001.guard_01.facet_individuals; character_blueprints_pilot_001.guard_01.facet_devotion develops only after a further explicit platonic acceptance in character_blueprints_pilot_001.guard_01.node_trust.
resolution_branches.base_personality_change: None; strategist and restrained voice remain. The proposed Orc-player 80 loyalty ceiling lifts only on this evidenced branch and never jumps loyalty to 100.

resolution_branches.name: Refuse a manufactured ending when the target or proof is unavailable
resolution_branches.trigger: Player explicitly elects to stop seeking a currently unverifiable warband link, after clear warning of what remains unresolved; may instead defer the still-latent offer.
resolution_branches.resolved: The decision to stop hunting an unknown opponent can close the optional activity without inventing revenge or an enemy.
resolution_branches.remaining_conflicts: The historical grievance and, for an Orc player, proposed 80 cap remain unresolved; no claim of reconciliation, specialized mastery or recovered property.
resolution_branches.facet_changes: No belief conversion or devotion; established identity may still be complete.
resolution_branches.base_personality_change: None; keep ordinary commentary and professional growth.

failure_and_recovery: Decline/defer: pause or explicitly close the SAME per-character offer; ordinary talks continue, and re-clicking cannot regenerate the warband facts or rewards. A final decline is confirmed and does not lock basic identity establishment.
Ally final hit: a verified team victory counts for the actual encounter outcome; never invent a personal killing blow or require one for a unique reward.
Actor down: if downed, suspend speech until conscious; preserve real outcomes caused by allies, including captures and deaths.

Target unavailable: if warband affiliation cannot be substantiated, no arbitrary Orc satisfies recognition; a dead, absent or escaped target is never respawned. Use existing evidence and an explicit uncertainty/abandonment route or keep the same offer latent.
Retreat, escape or mission failure: no verified revenge; permit future eligible mission only if naturally available, or intentional no-proof closure. Never spawn a replacement encounter.

Capture versus defeat: alive capture earns its own final status only after existing capture/recovery confirmation; unconsciousness and zero HP are not capture. Dead/defeated and escaped statuses are recorded separately.

Save/reload: saved individual facts, consent, recognized encounter identity, decisions, closure and once-only reward claim are deterministic. Reload replays the same committed state and never rolls a fresh personal target.
Competing activities: chain starts only when the character has no active major personal chain; no surprise reinforcements, altered main mission, or party betrayal.

conclusion.established_condition: The saved introductory disclosure plus route-memory and watchcraft talks reveal six fixed core facets without requiring success in the optional warband chain.
conclusion.core_closed_condition: An explicit, saved choice concludes the one warband chain on a verified specialization, credible reconciliation, or honest uncertainty outcome; any accepted unresolved chain stays open until deliberately deferred or closed.
conclusion.closed_behavior: Do not offer a new major warband grievance, random nemesis or repeatable one-off reward. Disable obsolete grievance-target prompts after an actual supported resolution, but do not erase the historical raid.
conclusion.continuing_growth: May react naturally to future missions and party relationships, continue combat progression and voluntary friendships. Reserved demeanor persists; no compulsory romance. Every new emotional story requires separate review.

reward_contracts.player_expectation: The player expects the raid’s truth to matter and disciplined protection work to yield more than a random sack of supplies.
reward_contracts.setup: The guard contrasts the failed convoy plan with the verified encounter and offers a single careful lesson, if a new training mechanic is approved.
reward_contracts.narrative_payoff: Accounts for the wrong without turning every Orc into an enemy; the guard recommits to guarding others.

grant_proposal.description: Review-only one-time, nonstacking defensive/formation-discipline benefit appropriate to the actual job, not an anti-Orc racial damage modifier; exact numerical effect, source and balance must be approved, or replace it with equivalently meaningful ordinary-loot training supplies before dialogue promises any mechanic.

reward_contracts.why_it_fits: The payoff follows the explicitly chosen specialization path; no made-up perk ID or unlimited stacking.
reward_contracts.alternative_branch_fairness: Reconciliation offers a differently valuable relationship and removal of the specific future cap; neither route may be framed as the only correct way to gain mechanical progress.

reward_contracts.player_expectation: The player expects that choosing accountability over collective suspicion changes the actual relationship, not just one line of dialogue.
reward_contracts.setup: The guard sees an Orc player keep a costly, prior commitment to treat a genuine perpetrator fairly, or, for non-Orc players, sees comparable verified principled conduct.
reward_contracts.narrative_payoff: The guard voluntarily names a particular person trustworthy while remembering the raid; platonic devotion is optional.

grant_proposal.description: Reviewed retirement of the specific Orc-player loyalty ceiling once a verifiable bridge is complete, with zero automatic loyalty points; optional once-only platonic bond:earned_devotion after an additional accepted pledge. Not a romance, skill, or new combat modifier.

reward_contracts.why_it_fits: Trust resolution directly addresses the cap’s original cause instead of using reward currency as forgiveness.
reward_contracts.alternative_branch_fairness: Specialization gives a reviewed professional reward and genuine personal closure; reconciliation gives sustained relational consequence without mandating romantic content.

reward_contracts.player_expectation: The player expects that declining invented proof will be respected, even if it cannot provide revenge loot.
reward_contracts.setup: No validated perpetrator, warband link or encounter outcome exists; the guard chooses whether to stop or wait.
reward_contracts.narrative_payoff: Honest acknowledgment of uncertainty without a false victory; the guard is still a person who can be understood.

grant_proposal.description: One-time narrative closure only if the player deliberately ends the hunt; no false recovered item, perk, loyalty increase or lifted Orc-player cap. Deferring leaves the same instance open and grants nothing.

reward_contracts.why_it_fits: An unavailable target cannot become an imaginary source of spoils or validated revenge.
reward_contracts.alternative_branch_fairness: This is an informed opt-out rather than a competing reward-maximization ending; the player may defer before deciding and never loses ordinary character progression.

remembered_facts: The specific convoy raid remains past fact after any ending.
Remember whether the warband link was ever verified; store capture, team defeat, death, escape and uncertainty as different outcomes, with accurate ally credit.
Remember branch selection, any Orc-player trust bridge, whether the 80 proposal is in effect, and whether platonic devotion was accepted; these are proposed persisted facts.
retired_hostile_lines: After active belief:distrusts_orcs has been replaced, retire blanket Orc-directed suspicion and all unresolved-hunt prompts. Specific grief or criticism of confirmed attackers may remain.
After specialization without reconciliation, retire repeat revenge offers but not honestly unresolved individual distrust; avoid automatic taunts against unrelated Orc allies.
new_voice_beats: Specialization: quieter confidence about patrol plans, credit for team effort, and a rueful acknowledgment that plans cannot undo the past.
Reconciliation: careful direct thanks to an Orc player who kept a promise, without sudden chattiness; possible reserved platonic vow if accepted.
Uncertainty: occasional thoughtful silence or ordinary guarded professionalism, not repeated demands for another enemy to spawn.
aftermath.personality_change_scope: The base strategist ID is unchanged in every branch. Only an explicitly resolved individual belief, optional bond and corresponding voice selection change; no combat-AI changes.
aftermath.relationship_change_scope: Only the evidenced reconciliation branch proposes removing this individual conditional 80 ceiling, without granting loyalty points. Platonic devotion requires another affirmative choice; romance is not authored in the pilot.

capability_requests.description: Persist an individual preassigned convoy-raid fact and reviewed connection to one particular hostile Orc warband, including no-match state; guard against random history rerolls.
capability_requests.reason: Registered history tag is proposed and cannot prove an encountered foe belonged to the same warband.

capability_requests.description: Introduce reviewed player.race context, pre-recruitment conditional 80 loyalty-ceiling support and clear UI disclosure, with cap-source accounting and precise lift; never retroactively reduce established loyalty.
capability_requests.reason: player.race and dynamic loyalty cap are not available in the predicate contract and are not prisoner resistance.

capability_requests.description: Support deterministic first meaningful prisoner intro, recruited companion talks, choice IDs, consent/decline/defer, and saved per-character facet transitions.
capability_requests.reason: Registered events are proposed; requires cannot express recruited status or saved conversation history.

capability_requests.description: Verify mission affiliation of an existing currently visible hostile Orc, preserve target identity, participation, ally final hit, downed actor, outcome distinctions, and saved interlude context.
capability_requests.reason: Target.race alone proves neither warband membership nor past hostility to the speaker; defeat, finalized capture, death, escape and retreat need reviewed provenance.

capability_requests.description: Store observable consequence of a player’s promised fair-treatment choice, gate active belief transformation and voluntary platonic bond, and block reward/repeat exploits.
capability_requests.reason: A dialogue choice cannot assert morality, change loyalty or create a bond without an approved transition and demonstrable event.

capability_requests.description: Review optional one-time job-appropriate, nonstacking professional training reward and an ordinary-loot fallback before promising it in text.
capability_requests.reason: No implementable perk or training reward identifier is supplied.

entries.title: The Workshop Ledger

authored_character_exclusions: Do not attach this optional individual workmanship error to every engineer, artisan, Gnome, Dwarf, Goblin or dutiful personality.
Exclude named lore characters with incompatible known work history; no invented mentor, client, workshop institution or universal local trade rule.
Assign the exact personal past mistake as a fixed proposed individual history fact before the first companion talk; never fabricate it on a later Talk click.

entries.core_promise: A sociable but exacting engineer learns that professional integrity requires recording mistakes and accepting help, not silently carrying every repair alone.

facets.claim: Has practiced ordinary repair and inspection work before joining the party.
prerequisites: Assign this fixed individual background before the post-recruitment introduction.
facets.provenance: Individual practiced trade; no claim about the race or a named workshop.

facets.claim: Takes genuine pride in careful work, especially plain things that do not break.
prerequisites: Assign as the individual voice profile, independent of race.
facets.provenance: Professional voice rooted in artisan and engineer experience.

facets.claim: Finds it easy to chat about tools and other people’s work, though not their own mistake.
prerequisites: Individual social variation is assigned from the start.
facets.provenance: Contrasts with blueprint 1 without treating dutiful as automatically outgoing.

facets.claim: Wants a dependable, repeatable way to check work rather than relying on a lucky successful repair.
prerequisites: Proposed motive assigned for this individual at creation.
facets.provenance: Ordinary professional ambition, not an unlock promise.

facets.claim: In one earlier job, this person signed off a faulty count, wasted materials and avoided telling anyone it was their mistake.
prerequisites: Needs a fixed authored personal history fact, proposed as history:unreported_quality_error; the past incident must exist before it can be told.
facets.provenance: Not supported by current history tags; new factual provenance must be reviewed and stored for this single instanced character.

facets.claim: Wants to make good on the wasted resources by sharing a reliable check method with somebody else.
prerequisites: character_blueprints_pilot_001.artisan_02.facet_error exists and is revealed in the saved confession conversation.
facets.provenance: Individual motive tied to the exact past mistake, not a generic guilt mechanic.

facets.claim: Becomes willing to let another person inspect work and correct an error without feeling personally erased.
prerequisites: A specific shared check is prepared and honestly reviewed after an eligible mission; must be accepted deliberately.
facets.provenance: Development from friendly talk to professional trust; compatible with being gregarious.

facets.claim: Begins to value shared responsibility in the party as much as being the one who can fix everything.
prerequisites: character_blueprints_pilot_001.artisan_02.facet_trust develops and the author-reviewed ledger conclusion records a truthful self-assessment.
facets.provenance: Open development, not a retroactive change to employment, race or base personality.

remaining_reveal_beats.beat: A chosen saved conversation reveals a specific already-assigned faulty count; without the approved individual history fact, withhold this autobiography rather than fabricate it.
After the confession, the engineer explains the wish to make useful amends by giving someone a reliable check method.
At a verified, consented two-person review, the engineer accepts a correction without seizing the tools back; optional development, not a new skill.
A later saved account of shared work changes the engineer’s idea of what a successful team looks like; it does not require a unique battle.

establishment.established_when: The saved companion introduction establishes craft pride, approachable manner and mastery motive; an optional ordinary talk with assigned personal-error provenance establishes the withheld mistake and desire to repay. It does not require a successful quest, manufactured mistake or main-mission objective.

reveal_beats: Saved early post-recruitment chat, after party membership is verified. The engineer cheerfully notices a loose fitting on their own kit, then checks it twice.
Voice: "A good repair is the one nobody needs to mention afterward." Reveal ordinary workmanship pride and sociable manner, not a hidden quest.
The engineer admits to chasing precision, without claiming an old mistake until a separate approved individual history fact exists.
No race, gender or romance assumptions; no conditional loyalty cap and no unrequested personal reward at introduction.

player_options.player_intent: Ask why the engineer checks everything twice.
player_options.consequence: Open saved conversation about standards; do not invent a training skill.
Record simple willingness to collaborate; no reward, quest or skills are granted by talk alone.
Saved first-conversation entry remains available; no pressure or missed reward.

conversation_nodes.when: After saved companion introduction; ordinary post-recruitment talk about inspecting equipment.
conversation_nodes.speaker_intent: Shares a practical check order and jokes gently about how unglamorous reliable work is.

choices.player_intent: Listen to their checklist.
choices.consequence: Establish voice and practical outlook, no mechanical effect.

choices.player_intent: Save the shop talk for later.
choices.consequence: No repeat rewards and no guilt pressure.

conversation_nodes.when: Only if the independently assigned history:unreported_quality_error exists and the introduction was saved.
conversation_nodes.speaker_intent: Chooses whether to tell the truth about one bad material count and its cost.

reveal_or_develop.transition: Reveal only the preassigned personal error.
Reveal the desire to repay the wasted work through better practice.

choices.player_intent: Acknowledge the mistake and ask what would repair the damage.
choices.consequence: No instant absolution; opens an optional constructive arc.

choices.player_intent: Ask them to write the correct record rather than hide it.
choices.consequence: They hear a standard, not condemnation; optional constructive arc remains.

choices.player_intent: Let the engineer keep the subject for another day.
choices.consequence: Leave fixed fact unchanged and permit the same talk later.

conversation_nodes.when: After the verified admission and repayment motive; companion is not running another major personal chain.
conversation_nodes.speaker_intent: Asks for permission to test a paired checking routine during ordinary preparations and an existing mission.

choices.player_intent: Agree to a genuine two-person check, including the chance to correct them.
choices.consequence: Arm character_blueprints_pilot_001.artisan_02.arc_ledger once; no mechanical buff or new field item.

choices.player_intent: Wait for a better time.
choices.consequence: Keep the exact same unarmed offer available; no penalty.

choices.player_intent: Decline a separate personal activity.
choices.consequence: Close the optional chain after confirmation; the engineer’s ordinary conversations and growth remain available.

conversation_nodes.when: After an honest recorded existing-mission result, including a non-success; never simply because an unrelated enemy fell.
conversation_nodes.speaker_intent: Invites an honest debrief, acknowledging whether the checklist was actually attempted.

reveal_or_develop.transition: May develop after a documented accepted correction, not merely mission success.

choices.player_intent: Compare what really happened and accept mutual correction.
choices.consequence: If a real paired check occurred, develop professional trust; never claim it occurred from a battle outcome alone.

choices.player_intent: Postpone the debrief.
choices.consequence: Preserve any verified events; do not award or reroll.

conversation_nodes.when: After a validated reviewed account has been completed or the optional task has been explicitly stopped.
conversation_nodes.speaker_intent: Explains that the practical lesson matters more than being the sole person who never slips.

reveal_or_develop.transition: Develop only on the shared-work closure, while keeping craft pride and dutiful personality.

choices.player_intent: Credit the work to both people and keep a truthful record.
choices.consequence: Conclude collaboratively once, including optional ordinary-material reward if approved.

choices.player_intent: Support a truthful private correction without public ceremony.
choices.consequence: Alternative non-spectacular closure with the same professional meaning, no new award type.

choices.player_intent: Leave the repair of trust unfinished.
choices.consequence: Defer the same saved instance; do not force a resolution or grant.

personal_arcs.armed_by: character_blueprints_pilot_001.artisan_02.node_offer / character_blueprints_pilot_001.artisan_02.offer_agree after a saved verified individual admission; one optional latent then active chain.

entry_conditions.review_only_context: Requires recruited status, the specific preassigned unreported-quality-error fact, saved player consent and a real existing mission; none is currently expressible as a dialogue predicate. No special enemy, crafting object, extra unit or mission is created.

participants: This recruited individual engineer, with an assigned personal workmanship mistake and ordinary repair skills; downing does not retcon earlier labor.
Player as a willing second checker and witness, not a mandatory romantic partner or a unique named NPC.
Any otherwise scheduled mission that permits a narratively documented preparation check and a later debrief; no bound enemy is required and no new spawn or special reward drop is assumed.

prerequisites: character_blueprints_pilot_001.artisan_02.offer_agree saved, individual history fact revealed, recruited, no conflicting personal chain.
milestones.player_objective: Agree on the two-person check, including permission to identify a genuine error, and record exactly what is planned.
milestones.scoring: Once-only saved agreement, with defer/decline retaining or ending the same offer. No equipment stat bonus or resource consumption is implied.

prerequisites: character_blueprints_pilot_001.artisan_02.milestone_agreement saved; normal mission is eligible and roster presence can be verified; reviewed preparation-confirmation event available.
milestones.player_objective: Before an existing mission, make one actual shared check of ordinary carried gear or recorded preparation, without spawning a broken object.
milestones.scoring: Record whether both sides did the check and whether correction was accepted; merely entering a mission, selecting a dialog option or winning combat never pretends the inspection was done. Missing event means remain pending.

prerequisites: character_blueprints_pilot_001.artisan_02.milestone_check verifiably performed; a real mission outcome or reviewed safe post-retreat debrief is available.
milestones.player_objective: Use ordinary mission experience to discuss whether sharing responsibility helped; success is welcome but not proof of flawless workmanship.
milestones.scoring: Verified mission success counts as the field test, not a special kill. If defeated, actor down or retreat occurs, save the observation and debrief safely at camp; a failed mission is honest learning, but may require one later ordinary eligible check before positive completion. Allied final blows are ordinary team results. Enemy capture and defeat are separate mission statuses, not inspection scores.

prerequisites: character_blueprints_pilot_001.artisan_02.milestone_field has a verified eligible review or an expressly saved non-success recovery path; engineer is conscious and original incident fact remains fixed.
milestones.player_objective: Decide how openly to document the old mistake and credit the new paired process; permit a truthful public-when-appropriate or private admission without conjuring prior colleagues.
milestones.scoring: Closure requires an explicitly recorded acknowledgment of fault, genuine mutual check/review and freely accepted collaboration; do not infer from a win, retreat or text click alone. Once closed, distribute at most one approved ordinary reward; deferral holds exact state.

resolution_branches.name: Shared record and admitted mistake
resolution_branches.trigger: Actual paired check, verified debrief, and voluntary choice to record the old mistake and credit the collaborator.
resolution_branches.resolved: Workmanship pride no longer requires sole ownership of perfection; the earlier count is truthfully acknowledged and future inspections are collaborative.
resolution_branches.remaining_conflicts: Still fussy about fittings and still dutiful; no magical repair mastery, instant public reputation or invented client forgiveness.
resolution_branches.facet_changes: Develop character_blueprints_pilot_001.artisan_02.facet_trust and character_blueprints_pilot_001.artisan_02.facet_belonging; retain established craft pride and gregarious humor.
resolution_branches.base_personality_change: dutiful remains dutiful; voice gains warmth about shared labor only.

resolution_branches.name: Private but truthful responsibility
resolution_branches.trigger: Same verified work, honest self-account and acknowledgment of shared contribution, but player chooses a private record instead of a public confession.
resolution_branches.resolved: Self-judgment softens without pretending the original mistake never happened; no inaccessible supervisor or former client must be spawned.
resolution_branches.remaining_conflicts: May be slower to speak openly outside the party; trust is selective and still grows.
resolution_branches.facet_changes: Develop character_blueprints_pilot_001.artisan_02.facet_trust and character_blueprints_pilot_001.artisan_02.facet_belonging on private truthful closure, not before.
resolution_branches.base_personality_change: No base personality or AI change.

resolution_branches.name: Stop the optional experiment without fictional success
resolution_branches.trigger: Player explicitly elects final stop when mission or check opportunities remain unavailable; a temporary defer is not final stop.
resolution_branches.resolved: The professional background remains understood even if no joint demonstration occurs.
resolution_branches.remaining_conflicts: Open trust/belonging developments do not auto-complete, and the past count remains truthfully remembered.
resolution_branches.facet_changes: Do not award character_blueprints_pilot_001.artisan_02.facet_trust or character_blueprints_pilot_001.artisan_02.facet_belonging without demonstrated work and acceptance.

failure_and_recovery: Decline/defer: explicit defer retains the same unarmed or armed per-character instance, while confirmed final decline ends only this optional challenge; early conversations and established identity continue.
Ally final hit: irrelevant to the inspection; any ordinary mission success is scored on mission status, not the engineer landing a blow.
Actor down: save the attempted check and genuine result; do not speak as if conscious. Resume debrief on recovery, and never fabricate fieldwork while unconscious.

Target unavailable: no enemy, rival, workshop supervisor or prior customer is required; if an ordinary mission or review partner is unavailable, defer or move to another already-scheduled qualifying mission, never spawn replacement characters.
Retreat or mission failure: no claim of a successful expedition or perfect repair; discuss failed preparation as learning and permit one later normal field check if required for closure.

Capture versus defeat: these are distinct possible ordinary mission outcomes; neither alone completes a personal inspection, captures require the existing finalized recovery status and no extra payout.

Save/reload: consent, original error, performance of the actual check, observed outcome, selected ledger account, facet development, and one reward entitlement are saved, not rerolled by a new Talk click.
Once-only payout is per instantiated character, with no repeating alternate ending to farm ordinary supplies or gold; incompatible concurrent chain stays unarmed.

conclusion.established_condition: Four facets become clear in the saved initial companion talk, and the preassigned mistake plus desire to repay become clear in a voluntary subsequent admission; skill, mission completion and payout are not prerequisites to recognizing the person.
conclusion.core_closed_condition: A saved final joint-review choice truthfully accounts for the former mistake after an actual shared check, or an explicit final opt-out closes the optional chain without falsely developing trust. Merely accepting a mission does not close it.
conclusion.closed_behavior: Once professional-accountability chain closes, no additional major quality-crisis backstory, random rival, same reward or new unfinished inspection is injected by default.
conclusion.continuing_growth: Craft commentary, practical advice, warm banter, shared achievement, ordinary combat progression and future interactions continue; no invented engineer skill unlock or romance requirement.

reward_contracts.player_expectation: The player expects fair acknowledgment of collaborative work and a modest tangible thank-you, not a powerful invented skill.
reward_contracts.setup: The engineer sets aside part of their ordinary previously earned workshop supplies to share once the paired check proves worthwhile; actual reward must be drawn from an approved ordinary-loot table.
reward_contracts.narrative_payoff: The real victory is a truthful corrected account and someone else being trusted to catch mistakes.

grant_proposal.description: Review-only one-off modest set of existing ordinary tool or maintenance supplies, subject to existing loot table and economy balancing; do not spawn a named special item or implement new skill.

reward_contracts.why_it_fits: Ordinary supplies fit an engineer learning to share work, while the emotional payoff is competence with accountability.
reward_contracts.alternative_branch_fairness: Private truthful accounting delivers an equally legitimate acknowledgement with a comparable modest reviewed grant, not a punishment for avoiding public exposure.

reward_contracts.player_expectation: The player expects a quieter route to doing the right thing without forfeiting all useful acknowledgment.
reward_contracts.setup: The engineer accepts another worker’s correction and keeps an accurate private account; no third-party confrontation is fabricated.
reward_contracts.narrative_payoff: They can admit fault and share credit without staging a public confession to nonexistent workshop staff.

grant_proposal.description: Review-only small fixed one-time amount of ordinary gold representing shared payment from previous legitimate work; exact amount, currency source and anti-farming limits require economy review.

reward_contracts.why_it_fits: Shared wages are a mundane professional reward; there is no fake skill, title or special tool.
reward_contracts.alternative_branch_fairness: Aim for comparable mundane value to the ordinary-loot branch after balancing, while retaining equivalent character closure.

reward_contracts.player_expectation: The player expects the voluntary personal activity to stop cleanly rather than pretend it was completed.
reward_contracts.setup: No genuinely verified joint check or completion exists.
reward_contracts.narrative_payoff: The engineer remains a full companion with already established pride and admitted mistake; no artificial absolution.

grant_proposal.description: No mechanical grant or developed open facets from an unperformed task. A deliberately final stop closes the optional offer once; an ordinary defer grants nothing and keeps the same instance.

reward_contracts.why_it_fits: No work was done to merit workshop proceeds, and no fictitious professional success is announced.
reward_contracts.alternative_branch_fairness: Declining a voluntary activity does not confiscate normal gear, prevent regular leveling or reduce loyalty.

remembered_facts: Remember the single specific faulty materials count only after the independently assigned individual history has been revealed.
Remember whether the paired inspection actually happened, whether an honest correction was accepted, the actual mission outcome, the selected truthful-account branch and the one-off reward claim.
Do not assert former clients, named workshops or retrospective career victories absent supporting facts.
retired_hostile_lines: Retire self-defeating "only I may check" comments after verified collaboration; this character never has a racial-hostility line family.
Stop re-offering the unresolved inspection once it closes, but do not remove ordinary careful-work observations.
new_voice_beats: After verified collaboration: "I checked it twice. You caught the third thing." Dry warmth, not performative shame.
After a quiet account: small gratitude for the partner who corrected them without a scene.
After a final opt-out: responsible everyday repairs without pretending a personal lesson was learned in play.
aftermath.personality_change_scope: Base dutiful personality persists. Early gregarious talk and craft pride remain, while optional professional trust and desire to belong broaden ordinary voice; no combat-AI edit.
aftermath.relationship_change_scope: May respect the player as a reliable collaborator after verified mutual work, with no specified numeric loyalty benefit and no romantic implication.
